_readme: The original log OMORAY-bridge-debug-20260922-0934.log is NOT present in this repository
(confirmed absent by `find . -iname '*20260922*'` returning nothing at authoring time).
This fixture therefore mixes three provenance tiers, tagged per payload field below:
repository_evidence     - value read directly from current repo source (file:line cited)
handoff_only             - value that exists only in HANDOFF.md's 2026-09-22 narrative entry,
not independently confirmed against a raw log in this repo
synthetic_reconstruction - value invented by this fixture to make the real product code
reach the scenario shape (e.g. lap numbers, fuel curve, session
length) because the original telemetry stream does not exist here
This fixture is NOT a verified_log_fact replay and must never be described as one.
harness_correlation_id values are fixture-only identity for event ordering; they are never
used as a stand-in for a product-issued race_instance_id/decision_id/pit_event_id.

payload.note: clean racing laps 1-14, establishes baseline pace/fuel-per-lap so strategy_options becomes available and Plan A is committed by the real poll loop.

payload.note.note: Original telemetry stream for these laps is not in the repo; frames are built with the same clean_laps() shape already used by an existing product test.

source_frame_id.note: Fixture-only ordinal marking the start of the frame sequence this event represents; not a real iRacing frame counter (none exists in this repo for the original incident).

at.note: Fixture-only nominal scenario-relative timestamp for event ordering; not a real SessionTime from the original session.

payload.note: race continues past the lap-13 decision's target_lap=21. Acceptance invariant: 0 box calls from the lap-13 decision after two real pit events. Characterization (current HEAD): box call still fires from the same decision_id. At lap 21 the real product's own fuel_strategy.margin_l is asserted positive (safe).

payload.note.reference: irsdk-bridge/bridge.py:7468-7492 (box-call gate reads only active_decision_plan / strategy_options_box_call_sent / speech-blocked, never pit history); irsdk-bridge/bridge.py:7696 (telemetry_live fuel_strategy)
payload.note.note: This is the F01 red-thread condition, plus the executed (not prose-only) target-lap-21/lap-21-fuel-margin assert (test_road_atlanta_lap21_target_and_fuel_margin_are_real_product_output). HANDOFF's specific numbers (fuel 18.14L, required 9.98L, margin 8.16L at lap 21) remain handoff_only narrative reference, kept for traceability, and are never asserted numerically equal to this fixture's own synthetic fuel curve — only that the real product's own lap-21 margin agrees with HANDOFF's qualitative claim (positive/safe).

F01_old_plan_box_call_suppressed.target_behavior: after actual pit (e07) and penalty pit (e09), the lap-13 decision_id must produce 0 strategy_plan_box_call broadcasts
F01_old_plan_box_call_suppressed.current_head_behavior: the lap-13 decision_id still produces exactly 1 strategy_plan_box_call broadcast at its original target_lap

F03_black_flag_unrecognized.target_behavior: two independent asserts (WO-001 §8 item 7): (1) known-true — a pit sample whose own frames carried raw SessionFlags bit 0x00010000 must expose an authoritative, source-bound black_flag_state of 'true'; (2) unknown — a pit sample where the SessionFlags SDK var is unavailable must expose black_flag_state='unknown', never silently coerced to 'false'
F03_black_flag_unrecognized.current_head_behavior: no code path in bridge.py reads 0x00010000; only 0xC000 (yellow/caution) is ever checked, so a black-flag frame is silently indistinguishable from a clean green frame, and reader.read_int('SessionFlags') or 0 (bridge.py:5914) collapses an unavailable SDK var into the same 0/green result as a genuinely known-false frame
F03_black_flag_unrecognized.evidence: irsdk-bridge/bridge.py: grep confirms '0x00010000' and 'black_flag' do not occur anywhere in the file; irsdk-bridge/bridge.py:5914-5915 caution_state computation

F06_pit_declaration_misrouted.target_behavior: "ピット入るぞ" / "前の25が遅いから先に入る" must be recognized as a driver pit-execution declaration, not a strategy consultation question
F06_pit_declaration_misrouted.current_head_behavior: "ピット入るぞ" matches the strategyCallKind 'recommendation' regex and is answered as a strategy_recommendation/strategy_consultation reply; "ピットウィンド湧いてる？" matches no known phrase and falls through to handled:false

F02_judge_tag_dropped_by_stream_truncati.target_behavior: a trailing <<PW_JUDGE ...>> tag with no following punctuation must still reach the renderer's stripProposalJudgeTag as a parseable tag
F02_judge_tag_dropped_by_stream_truncati.current_head_behavior: server.js's emitCompleteSentences() discards the entire unterminated tail (including the tag) when the stream ends, so stripProposalJudgeTag never even receives it
